results.detail: Implemented fresh-read overlap validation, atomic branch reservation, claim-pending assignment, global handoff audit/readback, claimed transition with session binding, and failure rollback; added admission precheck mode and self-test coverage to handoff-check.

limitations: Workflow behavior on GitHub Actions runners is not exercised locally; live dispatch evidence requires a maintainer-triggered run.
This is process/tooling evidence only; it does not provide DSP, physical audio, driver loading, WaveRT, HLK, Microsoft signing, or release evidence.
